prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game card illustration, full-bleed portrait 2:3, high-resolution PNG. Use one biome and one controlled magic accent per image. Basic but beautiful, not anime, not a chaotic poster. No text, letters, numbers, card frame, borders, logos, watermark or UI. No Chinese/East Asian fantasy, palace roofs, cloud-scroll ornament, calligraphy, jade pendants or eastern dragons. No blown-out whites or particle noise. Actual gameplay ability: Mở 3 Con Dấu chiến thuật, chọn 1 để đóng lên bài..
